package rulefixtures

import "fmt"

// scenario for migration_or_seed_logic_callable_from_request_handlers: Request handlers that can trigger migration or seed workflows.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.

func RunMigrations(dsn string) error {
	fmt.Printf("applying migrations to %s\n", dsn)
	return nil
}

func SeedDatabase(dsn string, fixtures []string) error {
	for _, f := range fixtures {
		fmt.Printf("seeding fixture: %s\n", f)
	}
	return nil
}

func AdminHandler(dsn string, action string) error {
	switch action {
	case "migrate":
		return RunMigrations(dsn)
	case "seed":
		return SeedDatabase(dsn, []string{"users", "products"})
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("unknown action: %s", action)
	}
}
